body.name: Тридцатипятилетние. Жанна. Лёня. Стас. Денис
body.summary: Since 1989, the authors have been tracking the lives of twenty children from various republics of the former Soviet Union, revisiting their stories every seven years. This time, the focus is on 35-year-olds.

show.name: Рожденные в СССР
show.summary: The documentary series "Born in the USSR" is a unique cinematic chronicle that began in 1989 and has been running for more than thirty years. The series' creators follow the lives of twenty children from different republics of the former Soviet Union, revisiting their stories every seven years. Today, the protagonists have grown up, and we see how their dreams, personalities, and outlooks on life have changed, and how they navigate the pivotal moments of their own coming of age and the maturation of the society around them.

show.name: Невский
show.summary: Since time immemorial, dark forces have been flattering themselves with the hope of conquering our beautiful planet. But every time they are opposed by heroes who stand up to defend their Motherland. Just such a hero lives in St. Petersburg. He is the most powerful and strong. He is so old that he himself has forgotten his name, so everyone simply calls him Nevsky. Once upon a time, it was he and several other heroes who stopped the countless armies of Pestilence, the conqueror of worlds. But the evil did not disappear, but hid in order to accumulate strength for a new invasion.

body.name: Серия 6
body.summary: Julia and Dima face new challenges of fate. Their careers as dancers depend on the choices they make.

show.name: Искусство падения
show.summary: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Against the Sky Supreme
show.summary: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

show.name: Cang Yuan Tu
show.summary: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

show.name: The Phoenix Perches
show.summary: Time-traveler Su Xiaochen paints fan art of the Prince to survive, uncovering his alter egos—which her kiss can swap.

show.name: The Phoenix Perches
show.summary: Time-traveler Su Xiaochen paints fan art of the Prince to survive, uncovering his alter egos—which her kiss can swap.

show.name: LINK CLICK
show.summary: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfil the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

show.name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
show.summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

body.summary: The best of the autumn, featuring a collection of star comedians brought together to make you laugh, with sketches about current events and life itself.

show.name: Humoretaten
show.summary: Eight comedians come together to make you laugh, with skits about current events and life itself.

show.name: Small Town Remedy
show.summary: This series tells the story of Liu Zhengliang (Played by Xiao Zhan), a genius doctor who suffers a major life setback and is forced to return to his hometown to start over. He gathers a group of seemingly "unreliable" people, and they passionately commit to doing the most reliable, meaningful things. Surrounded by the cozy, bustling neighborhood vibe, they weave warm daily moments with human kindness, offering life prescriptions that heal people's souls.

show.name: The Lament of Autumn
show.summary: In the turbulent 1920s, Yu Changxuan and Ye Pingjun fall into a love-hate entanglement, defying war and fate together.

show.name: Where the Mask Ends
show.summary: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

show.name: My Loong
show.summary: Yue Wangshu, the daughter of a military family, is offered as a sacrifice to the Dragon Abyss. There, she accidentally releases the Dragon Lord Li Zhi. From hostility to mutual understanding, they form an alliance based on a bargain to suppress the Li Fire. She uses the Dragon Lord's power to fight back against the plots of the Yue family and Prince Qi, while he learns human love through her. Ultimately, Li Zhi chooses to remain in the human world, and the two create an epic romance.

show.name: First Love Again
show.summary: Zhou Xiangxiang, a spirited and aspirational girl, and Gu Han, an aloof basketball prodigy, are childhood friends who reunite after years apart due to a misunderstanding. As their rivalry intensifies, they gradually transform each other while witnessing one another bravely chasing their dreams — a heartwarming love story that evolves from bickering rivals into a textbook romance.

show.name: Besties' Coming Fortune
show.summary: Modern-day best friends Tian Yuyuan and Lin Shutiao unexpectedly find themselves transported into a novel about household power struggles. They become sisters-in-law destined to be framed in a flower boat scandal on their wedding night and die together as sacrificial characters. The two team up to thwart the eldest sister-in-law and the adopted daughter, Shen Wanwan, as they expose one scheme and trap after another, making money along the way to survive. Shen Cheng, the cold and aloof heir, is afflicted with a deadly poison and needs the heroine's blood to stay alive, while Shen He, the unruly third young master, secretly aspires to become a coroner. Romance gradually blossoms between the two couples. However, the reborn original heroine Song Zhang and the Third Prince, who plots rebellion, launch a series of attacks. The four join forces to investigate an old case at Qiyun Pass, find witnesses who can testify to the injustice, and expose the Third Prince's serious crimes. They clear the Shen family's name and ultimately escape their predetermined tragic fate, living peacefully together.

show.name: Dear Song
show.summary: To seek justice for her father, Yu Song takes a job as an assistant in the Song household. Her sincerity wins Song Cheng over, and she teams up with Jing, a driver, to gather evidence and expose the Song family's crimes. But she refuses to let hatred consume her. She breaks free from what has held her back and realizes that real victory means taking control of her own life. In the end, she embraces life with newfound freedom and hope.

body.name: Mensamedlemmet
body.summary: Can you tell how smart someone is just by looking at them? And who resorts to bluffing when the goal is to identify and eliminate the person in the group who performed worst on a quiz?

show.name: Bløff
show.summary: In a fairytale castle, ten contestants compete against each other in a game that isn't about how smart you are, but about how smart people think you are.

show.name: Slumbering With Wolves
show.summary: Focusing on the growth of young people in the new era and the pursuit of the rule of law and justice, the story follows criminal psychology expert Gu Yan and his partner Shen Yu as they stay true to their original ideals and justice, work together to solve perplexing cases, and uncover the truth. Blending suspenseful mind games with reflections on human nature, it focuses on real-world issues such as moral limits and self-protection. It keeps pace with the times, with a fresh narrative approach and tight pacing.

Wei Tian, a man with top-level protective skills, loses his wife and daughter in a terrorist attack. He assumes a hidden identity in Antilocaris and forms a private security squad called "The Silent Ones" to protect Chinese compatriots living abroad.

body.name: Episode 1
body.summary:
Ex-con Joe Ruby is a volunteer at a local priory, tending to the grounds, seeking forgiveness and attempting to start a new life, all under the kind but watchful eye of Father David.

But when the body of one of the monks is found hastily buried in a remote part of the priory grounds, Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell and her green second-in-command DS Raj Singh are sent to investigate.

The mysterious circumstances make it a tricky case to solve. What secrets are these sacred grounds hiding? And what do these God-fearing suspects know about the murder? There's Brother Christopher, the gentle monk who loves to garden, Sister Marie, the stern but kindly nun who runs Bible class and Father David, the cryptic, ever-wise prior. Alongside them is the victim's brother Benedict, who is someone in need of support and money. And then there's Joe himself, who with his criminal past becomes suspect number one for Rose and Raj.

But when Joe comes up with some insights from his own dodgy history, Rose senses that Joe may prove useful after all.

Finding themselves investigating alongside each other, Joe and Rose set out to solve the mystery of who killed Brother Mark, frustrating each other at every turn, only to uncover a truth far more shocking than either anticipated.

show.name: The Northumbria Mysteries
show.summary:
Set against the sweeping Northumberland coastline and its surrounding market towns, the series centres on an unlikely crime-solving duo.

Joe Ruby, a jack-of-all-trades whose life has been shaped by mistakes, regrets and missed opportunities, alongside Oxford-educated DI Rose O'Connell, a rarefied intellectual, a deep thinker with a brilliant mind and an ice-cool disposition.

In a classic odd-couple pairing, Joe and Rose combine their talents as they frustrate, confound and ultimately surprise one another while unravelling a series of compelling crime mysteries.

body.name: Episode 2
body.summary:
When an exclusive, high-roller poker night ends with the murder of oil magnate and seemingly devoted family man Jeremy Hare, Rose and Raj find themselves completely out of their depth in the gambling world. The evidence is perplexing. Jeremy's substantial winnings from the night are still on his body, and he's been stabbed with an ornate, ceremonial golden knife that was left at the scene. Unfamiliar with the complex strategies and unspoken rules of high-stakes poker, Rose and Raj are left struggling to decipher the various hidden motives of the players around the table.

The game was hosted by Ace Dawso, a slick operator and local villain, with whom Joe and Rose have had a previous run-in. Ace's invitation-only matches attract an elite, ruthless crowd. There's Rami Ashraf, an enigmatic Egyptian playboy and seasoned poker pro with secrets to protect; Eleanor Calvert, a sharp stock-market whiz and one of the country's wealthiest, most calculating women; and Ace himself, who sat out the fatal hand but oversaw the room with a watchful eye. Every player present had something to lose and possibly a reason to want Jeremy silenced.

Baffled by the tight-lipped suspects who can quickly tell that she doesn't understand the game, Rose soon realises that conventional police work won't crack this case. She has no choice but to recruit Joe, whose history makes him the ultimate insider. Enticed back into the illicit world of gambling, Joe is forced to confront the dangerous addiction that nearly ruined his life. To help Rose read the table and flush out a cold-blooded killer, Joe must walk a risky tightrope, gambling not just with cash, but with his own addictions.

body.name: Episode 3
body.summary:
A healthy young labourer is found dead in a shallow ornamental pond on the vast country estate of Lady Philippa Armstrong and her son Jonathan. While the tragic incident initially appears to be nothing more than a straightforward workplace accident, Rose and Raj are called in to investigate glaring discrepancies. After all, how does a strong young man manage to drown in mere inches of water?

Meanwhile, Joe overhears staff from Gallowbrae Hall discussing the suspicious death. Having spent much of his youth stealing from the estate, Joe knows the local personalities and the layout of the property inside out. Believing he can be of genuine help to an unconvinced Rose, he eagerly inserts himself straight into the investigation. Finding themselves reluctantly paired up once again, Rose and Joe must untangle the messy, tight-knit relationships of Gallowbrae's eccentric inhabitants.

At the centre of the drama are the Armstrongs, an old-money family desperately holding onto what's theirs while caught in a fierce controversy over a new rewilding scheme. This scheme will close off public land to reintroduce sensitive wildlife and plants, sparking intense outrage from one local inhabitant in particular. Adding to the tension are Maxine, the devastated housekeeper who keeps her cards close to her chest; Whittick, the grouchy gamekeeper fiercely determined to protect Gallowbrae at any cost; and Gavin, the angry intruder and conspiracy theorist who views the aristocratic family and everything they stand for as completely abhorrent.

Struggling to navigate the complex social dynamics of the estate, Rose reluctantly accepts Joe's persistent interference. Together, the duo soon uncover a dark web of deep-seated secrets and lies within the family and their devoted staff.

body.name: Episode 4
body.summary: When estate agent Luke Wandle is found brutally murdered in his own office, Rose and Raj are met with a tangled web of motives. Naturally, suspicion falls on the two people who discovered the body: Luke's wife, Catherine, and his business partner Damon. But as the investigation deepens, the suspect list rapidly expands to include an embittered former employee with an axe to grind and Luke's tight-lipped secretary and her controlling husband, all hiding secrets of their own.

body.name: Feels Like Home
body.summary: Hollywood legend Bill Murray begins a journey around Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. But travelling with Bill rarely goes to plan. In Kinsale, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while friend and golf writer Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track. Golf brought Bill to Ireland, but the best moments often happen far from the course.

show.name: A Course Called Ireland
show.summary:
This isn't just a show about golf — it's a celebration of life going gloriously off course. In this series, Bill Murray and good friend and author, Tom Coyne play their way across some of the island's most legendary golf courses. But somewhere between the first tee and the final pint, the journey veers off course to meet the people who give it its soul, and why Bill loves his Irish heritage so much.

Each episode follows Murray and friends across some of the island's most breathtaking fairways, with every episode featuring a different golf course and guest.

The series offers an intimate portrait of an island whose stories, people and craic prove just as unforgettable as Bill Murray himself.

Golf is just the excuse.

body.name: The High Notes
body.summary: Irish film star Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts – and staying on the sidelines proves impossible.

The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

show.name: Mystery Science Theater 3000
show.summary:
Mystery Science Theater 3000 started as a locally produced television show for KTMA in Minnesota but soon grew in popularity. It moved to Comedy Central (originally the Comedy Channel), then to Syfy. After an eighteen-year hiatus, the crew of the Satellite of Love returned in 2017, airing on Netflix for two seasons. In 2021, the production started its own streaming service, The Gizmoplex, where the riffing of cheesy movies continues. Rifftrax revitalised the series once again in 2026 with four more episodes of the series. 

Over the years, there have been several "test subjects": Joel Robinson, Mike Nelson, Jonah Heston, and Emily Connor along with their robot friends Tom Servo, Crow T Robot, and Gypsy (now GPC) all subjected to bad movies thanks to a host of mad scientists including Doctor Clayton Forrester, his mother Pearl, and most recently Kinga Forrester.
